chunks: Then He will raise him up again when He pleases.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God raises someone up when He wills?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the concept of *Ikhtiyar* (divine choice) within God's absolute *Qudrah* (power), affirming that resurrection is not merely a mechanical event but an act of divine will. It serves as a potent reminder of the Hereafter (*Ma'ad*), reinforcing the accountability of human actions as witnessed by the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) in the context of Surah Abasa.
